title: Pocket Tuxemon
intro: Tuxemon's world, automatically imported into Pocket RPG Kit. Maps, art, characters and story are from Tuxemon (github.com/Tuxemon/Tuxemon), GPL-3.0 and CC BY-SA; per-asset credits are in this repository's licenses/TUXEMON-ATTRIBUTIONS.md.

pocket-tuxemon.title: Pocket Tuxemon
pocket-tuxemon.description: Play the Spyder campaign from the new-game bedroom to the recovered hospital cure — 263 imported maps with NPCs, dialogue, shops and real battles. Use the chapter buttons to jump into any story beat, or warp to any map.

controls.action: Open the demo menu (chapters, map warp, autoplay)
